newsitem.title: LEBANON: Fifth Lebanese bank taps Eurodebt market.
newsitem.headline: Fifth Lebanese bank taps Eurodebt market.

text.p: Banque Libano-Francaise became on Wednesday the fifth Lebanese bank to tap the international debt market with a heavily oversubscribed $125 million five-year EuroCD issue.
The issue brought to $595 million the total of funds that Lebanese banks have raised on the international market since last June.
Lead manager Indosuez Capital said the issue was increased at the last minute to $125 million from $100 million due to heavy demand.
The demand also enabled Indosuez to price it at the lower end of the proposed spread of 225-245 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes.

"Initially we said 225-245 but because of the large success of the issue we have issued on the lower part of the spread at 225 basis points over U.S. Treasuries," an Indosuez official in Beirut told Reuters.
"It was largely subscribed abroad, not in Lebanon, and we closed the deal in two days in view of the large success," he said.
The issue was priced at $99.90 but the official said it rose sharply in early trading in London to $101.375 and was yielding 8.60 percent.
A Beirut banker called the issue "a good deal" and said the spread was an improvement on the five-year rate for Lebanese banks in the EuroCD market.
"I'm bullish on this because Libano-Francaise is a good bank and it's 51 percent owned by Indosuez and that makes it a very good risk," the banker said.

"A lot of the tightness of the spread is driven by the limited outstanding paper for that name. It's the first issue for this name, so typically buyers would have an appetite for the credit risk," he added.
Banque Libano-Francaise had the biggest profit in 1996 among Lebanon's 82 banks and was fourth in size of assets and customer deposits.

"Libano-Francaise is very well appreciated in the market for its results and management. I would say the main factor in the success of the issue is people's confidence in it as one of the best banks in the country," an Indosuez official said.
